description_en: Invokes this operation to configure project cooperation settings so that an Alibaba Cloud account can grant authorization on different projects to different Resource Access Management (RAM) users
description_zh: 调用该接口设置项目协作，即阿里云账号可以给不同的RAM用户授权不同的项目
name: SetStudioProjectCooperation

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project cooperation status. Valid values:
- **0** (default): disabled.
- **1**: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
设置项目协作状态。
- **0**（默认）： 关闭。
- **1**： 开通
parameters.name: status
